Policy Name: Cigna ACDF (CMM-601: Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion)

Required findings: ≥ 6 months elapsed since the prior cervical decompression or fusion at an adjacent level

Both: (a) clinically significant daily pain causing functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing) AND (b) unremitting radicular pain to the shoulder girdle and/or upper extremity resulting in disability

Physical exam demonstrating any of: dermatomal sensory deficit, biceps/triceps motor weakness, reflex changes, shoulder abduction relief sign, Spurling's maneuver positivity, OR unremitting radicular pain without concordant objective findings

Failure to achieve clinically meaningful improvement after at least two of the following for ≥ 6 weeks (unless contraindicated): prescription‑strength analgesics/NSAIDs/steroids/gabapentinoids, provider‑directed exercise program, epidural steroid injection or selective nerve root block at the same level(s)
Plain cervical spine X‑rays (including flexion/extension lateral views) showing successful decompression and fusion at the prior operative level

MRI or CT of the cervical spine demonstrating neural structure compression at the proposed level(s) concordant with symptoms/exam and attributable to herniated disc(s), synovial/arachnoid cyst, central/lateral/foraminal stenosis, or osteophytes
No unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorder (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid or alcohol use disorder)

Nicotine‑free status documented as either a never‑smoker or abstinence from smoking/tobacco/NRT for ≥ 6 weeks prior to surgery, verified by objective cotinine testing (serum, urine, or saliva) within normal range

Symptoms of any of the following: upper or lower extremity weakness, numbness, or pain; fine motor dysfunction (e.g., difficulty buttoning, handwriting); gait disturbance; new‑onset bowel or bladder dysfunction; frequent falls

Physical exam demonstrating any of: abnormal grip‑and‑release test, ataxic gait, hyperreflexia, Hoffmann sign, Babinski sign, tandem walking ataxia, inverted brachial radial reflex, increased muscle tone/spasticity, clonus, or myelopathic hand
MRI or CT of the cervical spine showing findings concordant with the patient’s symptoms and exam and caused by cervical spinal cord compression or cervical spinal stenosis

Non-Indications: Less than six months since the prior cervical decompression or fusion at an adjacent level for radiculopathy
Absence of the required symptom profile (e.g., no daily functional‑impairing pain or no unremitting radicular pain for radiculopathy; no myelopathic symptoms for myelopathy)
Lack of any qualifying physical‑exam findings as specified for the condition
Failure to complete at least two required conservative therapy modalities for six weeks (unless a documented contraindication exists)
Imaging that does not demonstrate neural compression at the proposed level or does not show successful prior fusion
Presence of an unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorder
Active tobacco use without documented cessation or without objective cotinine test confirming nicotine‑free status
Important criteria & exceptions: Objective cotinine testing (serum, urine, or saliva) must be performed and reported as within normal range to verify nicotine‑free status
Conservative therapy requirement may be waived only if a documented contraindication to the therapies exists
Plain cervical spine flexion/extension lateral X‑rays are required to confirm successful prior decompression/fusion before considering adjacent‑level ACDF
All imaging findings must be concordant with the patient’s clinical presentation
Documentation required: Operative report from the prior cervical decompression or fusion procedure
Plain cervical spine X‑ray series including flexion and extension lateral views demonstrating prior fusion status
MRI or CT report of the cervical spine showing neural compression at the requested adjacent level
Radiology report confirming successful decompression/fusion at the previous operative level
Detailed physical‑exam note documenting sensory, motor, reflex, or myelopathic findings
Prescription records and pharmacy dispensing records for analgesics, NSAIDs, steroids, gabapentinoids used for ≥ 6 weeks
Physical therapy or chiropractic progress notes confirming a ≥ 6‑week supervised exercise program
Pain‑management or interventional radiology notes confirming epidural steroid injection or selective nerve root block at the same level(s)
Behavioral health evaluation note confirming absence of unmanaged significant mental/behavioral health disorders
Smoking history documentation and objective cotinine test result (serum, urine, or saliva) within normal limits
